lines.text: Chapter 2: The Bitcoin Law
lines.say: Chapter two. The Bitcoin Law.

lines.text: Bitcoin is a digital currency with no central bank. Its price is set by trading, around the clock.

lines.text: In June 2021, El Salvador's congress passed the Bitcoin Law: the first country to make bitcoin legal tender.

post.title: El Salvador made bitcoin legal money in 2021. Why did about 92% skip it in 2024?
post.ig: El Salvador made bitcoin legal tender in 2021. By 2024, about 92% of people didn't use it. Here's what happened.

post.yt_desc:
In September 2021, El Salvador became the first country to make bitcoin legal tender and gave $30 in bitcoin to every adult who signed up for its Chivo wallet. This video explains why a country that has used the US dollar since 2001 tried bitcoin, what surveys found about who actually used it, how the government built a stash of about 7,825 coins (as of Nov 4, 2026), and how a $1.4 billion IMF loan approved in February 2025 made bitcoin acceptance voluntary. Along the way we chart remittances as a share of El Salvador's economy and work through the math on the government's holdings and the IMF loan per person.

CHAPTERS

Sources: IMF press releases (Dec 18, 2024; Feb 26, 2025; Dec 22, 2025; Oct 1, 2026); NBER Working Paper 29968 (2022); UCA IUDOP surveys (Jan 2024, Jan 2025); World Bank, personal remittances % of GDP; Banco Central de Reserva via Diario El Mundo (2022-2026); Al Jazeera (June 2021); The Block (Sept 2021, July 2025, Nov 2025, Sept 2026); Kitco (Nov 17, 2022); Bloomberg (Nov 2021, Nov 2025); Fortune (Dec 2023; Nov 4, 2026); Reuters (Jan 2025); CoinDesk (Sept 2026).
